programme.required_evidence: site, title, authority and evidence-gap register
programme.release_condition: All mandatory roles and unknowns are named; no site work authorized
programme.stop_or_rollback: Do not proceed; keep concept off site

programme.required_evidence: authorized title, measured, access, fire, structure and utilities briefs
programme.release_condition: Carrier M is not disqualified and professional surveys are commissioned
programme.stop_or_rollback: Reject carrier M or stop until official inputs resolve

programme.required_evidence: future consent plan, access-support plan, service blueprints and dissent log
programme.release_condition: Every scenario has staffed and non-digital continuity requirements

programme.package_en: Tabletop, cost baseline and procurement pack
programme.required_evidence: twelve scenario receipts, cost recalculation and clause compliance matrix
programme.release_condition: All negative cases block release and arithmetic independently reproduces

programme.required_evidence: component inspection, isolated shutdown and human-route rehearsal records
programme.release_condition: Ordinary passage and same-task service survive equipment shutdown
programme.stop_or_rollback: Remove failed interface and retain ordinary service

programme.required_evidence: permits/authorizations if applicable, installation checks and accessibility acceptance
programme.release_condition: Every required authorization and independent acceptance is evidenced
programme.stop_or_rollback: Deinstall, repair and do not open

programme.required_evidence: incident, continuity, appeal, deletion and restoration drill receipts
programme.release_condition: Duty and stop roles respond; unresolved material failures equal zero
programme.stop_or_rollback: Pause AI path; keep staffed route; correct or exit

programme.package_en: Independent release, revise or exit decision
programme.required_evidence: independent decision record, public register and signed close-out/next-stage conditions
programme.release_condition: Explicit named authorization exists; otherwise default is no release
programme.stop_or_rollback: Exit, verified deletion, deinstallation and restoration

programme.required_evidence: measured service, equity, incident, cost and maintenance receipts
programme.release_condition: Public value and same-task access remain acceptable under approved thresholds
programme.stop_or_rollback: Pause affected service or execute exit plan

programme.package_en: Annual continue, revise or exit review
programme.required_evidence: annual accessibility, procurement, cost, data, asset and co-design audit
programme.release_condition: Named authority accepts next-year scope and funding; no silent renewal
programme.stop_or_rollback: Expire contract, hand over, delete and restore

programme.required_evidence: whole-life cost, component disposition, verified deletion and restored-surface record
programme.release_condition: New authorization and public-value case exist or ordinary service is fully restored
programme.stop_or_rollback: Default to full exit and publish close-out

gate_definitions.G1: carrier, survey and public-service definition gate
gate_definitions.G4: independent release, continuation or exit gate

default_rule: Missing evidence, authority, funding or acceptance means stop; time elapsed never releases a gate.
non_commitment: The programme is conditional and implies no site, funding, procurement, participant, operator or authorization.
